visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, dark brown hair and a white t-shirt is centered in the bottom half of a vertical frame. She sits in a high-back gaming chair with red and blue accents against a plain white wall. She is talking animatedly, with frequent mouth movements and changes in facial expression, ranging from serious to smiling. Above her, a game interface from 'Arena of Valor' is visible, showing a character moving through a green forest-like environment with various UI icons like ability buttons and health bars. (2) The woman continues her narrative, using moderate hand gestures to emphasize her points. The lighting is bright and even, typical of an indoor home studio setting. The gameplay on the top half shows the character engaging in minor combat actions, with health bars fluctuating and skill icons going on cooldown. Yellow text overlays with black borders appear frequently in the center-right of her frame. (3) The woman leans slightly forward and then adjusts her hair, smiling as she recounts a story. The camera is static, maintaining a medium close-up of her upper body. The gameplay footage transitions through different sections of the map, maintaining a vibrant color palette of greens and blues. A social media handle and brand logo are permanently displayed at the bottom of the screen. (4) As the video nears its end, her expressions become more humorous and exaggerated. She looks directly at the camera with wide eyes during specific points of her story. The gameplay above continues to show team-based movements. The video concludes with her laughing and looking slightly off-camera as the last text overlays appear.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice begins speaking with a high-arousal, cheerful tone and a rapid speech rate. The background music is an upbeat, electronic track with a consistent 4/4 beat and bright synth textures. The voice is clear with high pitch variability. (2) A subtle 'ding' sound effect marks a transition as the speaker's vocal inflection shifts to a narrative, storytelling mode. The BGM remains steady in the background at a lower volume relative to the speech. (3) The speaker laughs slightly, adding a 'breathier' texture to her voice, followed by a series of sharp 'pop' sound effects synchronized with the visual text overlays. The BGM continues to provide a playful atmosphere. (4) The vocal intensity increases during the punchline of the story, with the speaker using exaggerated pitch peaks. The BGM maintains its tempo until the end, where the track fades out along with the final words and a light-hearted closing laugh.

It uses a split-screen format to keep the viewer engaged with both the storyteller's expressions and gaming footage.
